mapper.sql: account.id, account.email, account.password_hash, account.role, account.email_verified_at, account.suspended_at, account.deleted_at, account.terms_agreed_at, account.created_at, company.id AS company_id, company.company_name AS company_name, company.business_number AS company_business_number
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account ( email, password_hash, role, email_verified_at, terms_agreed_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{emailVerifiedAt}, #{termsAgreedAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM account LEFT JOIN company ON company.account_id = account.id WHERE account.id = #{id} AND account.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT
FROM account LEFT JOIN company ON company.account_id = account.id WHERE account.email = #{email} AND account.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_session ( token_hash, account_id, last_used_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{tokenHash}, #{accountId}, #{lastUsedAt}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT session.id, session.token_hash, session.account_id, session.last_used_at, session.expires_at FROM account_session session WHERE session.token_hash = #{tokenHash}
